papers.title: Molecular Biology and Synthetic Biology-Guided Development of Recognition and Reporting Elements of Biosensor.
papers.abstract: Microbial cell biosensors are capable of detecting fluctuations in the concentrations of substances both inside and outside the cell, as well as changes in the external environment, and can generate measurable signal outputs. Microbial cell biosensors are characterized by low cost, simple operation, and high specificity. The rapid advancement of synthetic biology has significantly propelled the development and practical application of microbial cell biosensors. In this chapter, we provide a comprehensive summary of the composition and working principles of microbial cell biosensors. Additionally, we introduce various strategies and the latest progress in modifying biorecognition element and reporting elements using molecular biology and synthetic biology techniques in recent years. This book chapter offers new insights and valuable references for the research and development of microbial cell biosensors.

papers.title: "Illuminating" the silkworm chassis: Synthetic biology-driven evolution of genetic-based sexing circuits.
papers.abstract: The silkworm (Bombyx mori), a classical lepidopteran model, is evolving into a highly tractable synthetic biology chassis. In modern sericulture, genetic sexing circuits provide a rational design framework for efficient all-male rearing, effectively overcoming the gene dosage disruptions and fitness costs associated with traditional radiation-induced chromosomal translocations. This review systematically summarizes the construction strategies and industrial applications of these circuits. We outline the optimization of sex determination elements and highlight the advantages of far-red optical markers in penetrating host physical barriers and reducing cytotoxicity. Furthermore, we trace the evolution of genomic manipulation tools from random transposon insertions to targeted CRISPR/Cas9 integration into genomic safe harbors (GSHs). To address circuit instability during multigenerational rearing, protective molecular strategies-including boundary insulators, conditional expression, and automatic excision networks-are evaluated. We also explore the industrial interface that integrates standardized biological optical reporters with artificial intelligence and high-throughput optoelectronic sorting hardware. Ultimately, engineering principles derived from the silkworm chassis can provide a molecular framework for the sterile insect technique in global pest management, with future directions pointing toward footprint-free genome editing and dynamic conditional regulation.

papers.title: A cryptic lactate cycle in CO fermentation by Clostridium ljungdahlii .
papers.abstract: The valorization of C1 gases presents a route toward the utilization of industrial waste gases as resources. Acetogens such as Clostridium ljungdahlii serve as promising microbial cell factories for light-independent carbon fixation and high-value compound production, yet their efficiency is often limited by energy constraints and poorly understood metabolic pathways. Here, we investigated lactate metabolism in C. ljungdahlii during carbon monoxide (CO) fermentation via growth and product profiling, 13 C-labeling, gene knockouts, and transcriptomics. Although lactate cannot serve as the sole source of carbon and energy for C. ljungdahlii 's growth, we found that lactate can be co-fermented with CO into acetate. 13 C-tracing further revealed concurrent lactate production and oxidation during CO fermentation, with the unlabeled lactate fraction increasing from 1.0% (day 2) to 5.0% (day 6), indicating the existence of an active lactate cycle. Genetic and transcriptional analyses showed that lactate production and oxidation were catalyzed by two distinct lactate dehydrogenases: LdhA (CLJU_RS15865) and the electron-bifurcating Ldh/EtfAB_1 complex (CLJU_RS10590-CLJU_RS10600), respectively. Disruption of the lactate cycle, particularly in the Ldh/EtfAB_1 mutant, improved energy metabolism and triggered intracellular metabolic rearrangements. This mutant produced approximately 10-fold more lactate and shifted the acetate/ethanol ratio from 3.7:1 to 2.1:1, accompanied by upregulation of the AOR (aldehyde:ferredoxin oxidoreductase)-mediated ethanol production pathway. Subsequent ldhA overexpression further elevated lactate titer to ~2.5 mM, confirming the potential for lactate production from CO. The results imply that the cryptic lactate cycle dissipates energy but aids in intracellular redox balancing during CO fermentation. These findings provide new insights into the metabolic engineering of acetogens to produce target compounds, such as lactate and ethanol. Importance Acetogens possess a natural carbon fixation pathway, the Wood-Ljungdahl pathway, enabling them to fix CO or CO2 to produce acetate. Among various acetogens, Clostridium ljungdahlii exhibits strong tolerance to CO and thus holds great application potential for the resource utilization of syngas. However, the physiological and metabolic mechanisms underlying its autotrophic fermentation remain incompletely understood, which imposes limitations on metabolic engineering efforts. In this study, we systematically investigated lactate metabolism in C. ljungdahlii and revealed the existence of a cryptic lactate cycle during CO fermentation. By characterizing this cycle's operation and its impacts on energy metabolism and carbon distribution, we elucidated its potential physiological functions. These findings not only expand our understanding of the physiological and metabolic behaviors of acetogens during autotrophic fermentation but also provide theoretical guidance for the future metabolic engineering of lactate, ethanol, and other compounds.

papers.title: Biomanufacturing of L-Lactic Acid from Inulin Exploiting Kluyveromyces marxianus and Engineered Saccharomyces cerevisiae Cell Factories.
papers.abstract: The transition to sustainable lactic acid (LA) biomanufacturing necessitates a shift from first-generation feedstocks toward residual biomass and low-pH fermentation, eliminating the costly, waste-intensive salt purification and acidification steps. This study presents a novel, two-yeast strategy designed to valorize inulin, a fructose polymer also found in cardoon roots, for high-efficiency LA production at a pH below its pKa. The key novelty of this work lies in identifying and pairing the unique physiological strengths of each organism: Kluyveromyces marxianus as the optimal yeast for inulin hydrolysis, and Saccharomyces cerevisiae as the superior host for robust LA production at low pH and high titers. We discovered that if ammonium sulphate is substituted with urea as a nitrogen source for K. marxianus cultivation, the inulinase activity increased by nearly 20-fold, significantly enhancing the initial breakdown of the substrate. Inulinase-enriched K. marxianus supernatant was then used to cultivate S. cerevisiae m850, an engineered homolactic strain, and convert inulin into L-LA. Comparing separate hydrolysis and fermentation (SHF) with simultaneous saccharification and fermentation (SSF), we achieved a maximal yield > 0.77 g/g with a final pH of 2.5. While SSF was limited by pH-induced inulinase inactivation, the SHF process achieved complete substrate conversion. These results demonstrate a promising platform for producing LA from a residual feedstock, drastically reducing impacts and downstream processing costs.

papers.title: Carbon-Convergent Co-utilization of Ethanol and CO2 Enables Efficient 3-Hydroxypropionic Acid Biosynthesis in Komagataella phaffii
papers.abstract: Abstract CO 2 is an abundant feedstock for biomanufacturing, but its high oxidation state demands substantial reducing power for multicarbon biosynthesis. Here, we establish a carbon-convergent strategy for producing 3-hydroxypropionic acid (3-HP) through the co-utilization of ethanol and inorganic carbon in engineered Komagataella phaffii. Ethanol serves as a nexus molecule that supplies a conserved C2 backbone together with reducing equivalents, enabling a "2+1=3" route to 3-HP through inorganic C1 incorporation. Coordinated engineering of ethanol assimilation, acetate activation, carboxylation, cofactor supply, and energy metabolism generated strain LT-28, which produced 127.04 g/L 3-HP, the highest titer reported so far for CO 2 -based biosynthesis. 13C tracing verified the joint contribution of ethanol-derived C2 carbon and inorganic C1 carbon to the product skeleton. LT-28 also converted an unpurified ethanol-rich stream from thermocatalytic CO2 reduction into 3-HP. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of coupling chemical CO 2 reduction with microbial 3-HP biosynthesis through ethanol-mediated carbon convergence.

papers.title: Comparative Multi-omics Reveals Conserved Membrane Architecture and Selective Metabolic Cargo Enrichment Across Yeast-Derived Extracellular Vesicles
papers.abstract: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are fundamental mediators of intercellular communication across all kingdoms of life, yet our understanding of EV biology has been derived predominantly from mammalian systems. In contrast, yeast-derived extracellular vesicles (YDEVs) remain poorly characterized despite their potential as scalable, non-pathogenic platforms for biotechnology and metabolic engineering. Here, we combined a high-yield isolation workflow with comparative multi-omics to define the metabolically active cargo and membrane composition of EVs derived from three yeast species and four strains: the conventional model yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae (SC), the non-model oleaginous yeast Rhodotorula toruloides (RT-88), and two Yarrowia lipolytica strains, wild-type W29 and its engineered derivative Po1f. Using tangential flow filtration coupled with ultracentrifugation, we reproducibly isolated intact, bilayer-enclosed vesicles with conserved nanoscale morphology across all strains despite marked differences in EV yield. Comparative metabolomics revealed selective enrichment of distinct metabolically active cargo, including nucleotide metabolites in SC, fatty acids and acyl-carnitines in RT-88, and strain-specific metabolites within the Yarrowia isolates. Notably, nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD⁺) was enriched in SC and RT-88 EVs but was nearly absent from Yarrowia-derived vesicles, raising the possibility that EV encapsulation may facilitate protected transport of this otherwise membrane-impermeable cofactor. In contrast to these differences in cargo composition, comparative lipidomics demonstrated a broadly conserved membrane architecture across all strains, with only quantitative remodeling of specific lipid classes and membrane unsaturation profiles. Together, these findings support an organizational principle in which yeast-derived extracellular vesicles preserve a conserved membrane architecture while selectively enriching metabolically active cargo, establishing a comparative framework for understanding EV biology across evolutionarily diverse yeast species.

papers.title: Dynamic tapered nozzle and multiple waveform modulation enable high-speed piezoelectric jetting without satellite droplets across broad fluid property ranges.
papers.abstract: Piezoelectric drop-on-demand inkjet printing enables controlled microdroplet deposition in microfluidics, biomanufacturing, and precision manufacturing. However, conventional pressure chamber piezoelectric printheads are susceptible to viscous dissipation and nozzle clogging, exhibit limited adaptability to high-viscosity, low-surface-tension liquids and particle/cell suspensions, and struggle to suppress satellite droplets effectively. These limitations hinder their practical deployment in high-precision and high-stability inkjet applications. Here, a dynamic tapered nozzle generates droplets through local self-pumping induced by geometric deformation rather than pressure-wave propagation in a conventional pressure chamber. Structural optimization enabled droplet velocities of 5.42-12.67 m s -1 and stable ejection at viscosities up to 40.3 mPa s, surface tensions of 24.44-72.75 mN m -1 , and Z values of 1.01-38.11. Mechanistic analysis identified high-frequency residual nozzle oscillations as the primary cause of ligament stretching and secondary breakup. Based on this mechanism, a multiple waveform modulation strategy is devised to dynamically regulate the nozzle displacement response. This strategy effectively suppresses satellite droplets during high-speed ejection while maintaining printing throughput and achieves a 32% reduction in droplet diameter. The satellite-droplet suppression effect is further validated in a 0.5 wt% SiO 2 nanoparticle suspension and a 10 wt% PVP K30 solution. The platform enables high-viability printing of MC3T3 cells and carrier-free intracellular delivery of 70 kDa fluorescein isothiocyanate (FITC)-dextran, establishing a feasible pathway for high-speed and stable ejection across broad fluid property ranges with low clogging risk.

papers.title: Enhanced violacein production by synthetically engineered mutualistic Escherichia coli co-culture biofilms in a spatially partitioned bioreactor system.
papers.abstract: Violacein (VIO) is a bacterial secondary metabolite with potential applications in healthcare, textile, and cosmetic industries. Although modular synthetic E. coli co-cultures are promising for biomanufacturing, VIO production in such systems depends on efficient cross-feeding, which requires spatial proximity and stable interactions among co-culture members. Here, we demonstrate that a spatially partitioned bioreactor can support coexisting suspended and carrier-associated states of a mutualistic recombinant E. coli co-culture, enabling direct comparison of their crude VIO production performance. The co-culture was cultivated in a spatially partitioned bioreactor consisting of an aerobic stirred-tank compartment connected to an oxygen-limited cartridge containing Fibra-Cel® discs as carriers, thereby enabling biomass partitioning into suspended and adherent fractions. Across three biological replicates, the adherent biofilm-associated fraction consistently exhibited higher biomass-normalized crude VIO production than the corresponding suspended fraction, with 4.51-, 20.05-, and 5.51-fold increases. Although the adherent fraction represented only 10.6-24.0% of the total biomass, it contributed 35.4-86.3% of the total crude VIO. These results show that carrier-associated spatial organization within the partitioned bioreactor supported the formation of highly productive biofilm-associated E. coli co-culture populations. The presented concept highlights the potential of spatially organized, carrier-associated co-cultures for the intensification of secondary metabolite production and future biofilm-based bioprocessing applications.

papers.title: Genetic control couples TGFβ-independent pluripotent stem cell renewal to deterministic forward programming across germ layers
papers.abstract: Reproducible and scalable manufacture of human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC) derivatives requires control over expansion and differentiation. Transcription factor-mediated forward programming can place hiPSC differentiation under genetic control, but expansion still relies on extracellular growth-factor supplementation, increasing process complexity and operator dependence. Here we introduce GERALT (Genetically Enhanced Renewal and Autonomous Lineage Transdifferentiation), a push-pull genetic circuit assembled through targeted safe-harbour integration that couples NANOG-supported, TGFβ-independent renewal to doxycycline-inducible lineage programming and simultaneous NANOG silencing. GERALT maintained pluripotency during extended TGFβ withdrawal in both adherent and suspension culture, yet remained programmable towards myogenic, neuronal, and hepatic fates. Compared with the established OPTi-OX platform in myogenesis, GERALT enabled differentiation in simplified medium while canalising and accelerating commitment. GERALT also supported direct myogenic programming in suspension and enabled direct casting of hiPSCs into hydrogel followed by in-tissue programming, yielding electrically responsive engineered muscle tissues. These results extend genetic control upstream into stem cell renewal, facilitating deployment of new approach methodologies and other biomanufacturing applications.

papers.title: Kinetic metabolic modeling of Saccharomyces cerevisiae mutants reveals two major regulatory patterns of glycolytic flux control.
papers.abstract: Maintaining a high glycolytic flux is critical for robust ethanol fermentation and metabolic engineering in Saccharomyces cerevisiae. However, the regulatory mechanisms that prevent the excess turbo design structure of glycolysis under genetic perturbations are unknown. In this study, we constructed a kinetic model of yeast central carbon metabolism encompassing 90 reactions and 543 parameters. Using a genetic algorithm, we trained the model ensemble using multi-omics datasets (proteomics, metabolomics, and fluxomics) collected from the wild-type strain and 11 single-gene deletion mutants. Metabolic control analysis (MCA) of the calibrated models revealed that two major regulatory modes governed the glycolytic flux in most of the strains examined under the culture condition used in this study, although gcr2Δ exhibited a distinct control profile and gnd1Δ could not be reproduced by the model. The wild-type, gcn4Δ, and rpe1Δ strains exhibited an HXK-limited control mode, in which lowered hexokinase activity likely acts as a feedback limiter to prevent pathway over-activation. Conversely, seven other mutants shifted to an ATP demand-coupled mode, transferring flux control to energy-dissipating reactions and linking glycolytic flux directly to ATP demand. No single motif was uniformly shared within either group, implying that strain-specific expression adjustments repeatedly resulted in two regulatory modes. These findings elucidate the robust, multimodal control strategies employed by yeast to safeguard its high fermentation capacity and provide a theoretical foundation for targeted metabolic engineering and robust bioprocess design.

papers.title: Marrow-mimicry MEW scaffolds recapitulate erythroblastic islands for high-density cRBC biomanufacturing
papers.abstract: Biomanufactured cell therapies are delivering a step-change in modern medicine, but their high costs have prevented widespread adoption. Cultured red blood cells (cRBCs) are one type of cell therapy in clinical trials for off-the-shelf blood transfusion but remain limited by the exorbitant costs of manufacturing trillions of RBCs required for a blood transfusion. These costs could be mitigated if culture platforms could grow cells at higher density, like those found in the bone marrow, requiring less media and lower concentrations of expensive growth factors per cell. We engineered melt electrowritten (MEW) polycaprolactone (PCL) scaffolds in geometries which imitate marrow trabeculae structures and were then plasma-treated to enable peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PB MNC) attachment. PB MNC monocytes first adhered to the scaffold and rapidly differentiated into CD68 + macrophage-like cells. These macrophage-loaded scaffolds adhered CD71 + erythroblasts, which then grew from 10 to 25% between days 4 and 8 and produced CD235a + erythroid cells by day 20, under erythrogenic culture conditions. MEW PCL scaffolds in trabecular-like geometries had greater surface area, adhered more macrophages, and generated more erythroblasts than traditional MEW crosshatch geometries. The MEW scaffolds continuously released less-adherent cells to the supernatant, providing a 74% increase in supernatant cell numbers versus liquid suspension controls with identical cell seeding numbers and media volumes. High-cell-density scaffolds exhibited increased metabolism and endogenous production of self-supportive cytokines, which may offer cost-saving opportunities through future media optimisation. This study reports marrow trabeculae-mimetic MEW PCL designs capable of selectively adhering PB MN cells to develop macrophage-coated scaffolds, which provided physical and paracrine support for cRBC production. This high-cell-density culture platform may be useful for future cell therapy biomanufacturing protocols.

papers.title: Multilevel metabolic engineering of Bacillus amyloliquefaciens for enhanced L-tyrosine production.
papers.abstract: L-Tyrosine is a valuable aromatic amino acid with diverse applications. Although plasmid-based overexpression has markedly improved L-tyrosine production, the dependence on antibiotic selection and genetic instability under nonselective conditions limits its industrial applicability. To address these issues, this study employed a multi-level metabolic engineering strategy to enhance the L-tyrosine biosynthetic pathway at the genomic level in Bacillus amyloliquefaciens. First, an expression cassette containing the mutant prephenate dehydrogenase (TyrAI309A/E330V) was inserted into the genome of the wild-type strain Z1. When the copy number reached three (strain Z4), L-tyrosine production reached 437.43mg/L. Subsequently, the mutant DAHP synthase (AroAR27A/K38A) was integrated, and the resulting two-copy strain Z7 increased L-tyrosine production to 591.29mg/L. Systematic identification of rate-limiting steps showed that most pathway genes enhanced production to varying extents. A promoter in situ replacement strategy was then applied to construct strain Z21, which further increased the titer to 813.01mg/L. Finally, by optimizing precursor supply, the engineered strain Z32 reached an L-tyrosine titer of 1079.94mg/L. Overall, this plasmid-free and antibiotic-independent platform offers a promising strategy for stable biosynthesis of L-tyrosine and other aromatic amino acids in microbial cell factories.

papers.title: Protein resource allocation across subcellular compartments revealed by large-scale absolute quantitative proteomics in yeast.
papers.abstract: Subcellular compartmentalization within complex membrane-bound organelles is a hallmark of eukaryal life, enabling metabolic specialization through spatial segregation. Here, we compiled a dataset encompassing 300 absolute quantitative proteomes, the largest to date, across two yeast species under diverse experimental conditions. Leveraging big data analysis, formula fitting, and machine learning, quantitative correlations among protein abundance, resource allocation, and cellular phenotypes were elucidated at a system level. We found that subcellular resource distribution is highly uneven and covaries with specific growth rate. Specifically, at high specific growth rates, the protein mass fraction (PMF) from certain compartments, (e.g., nucleus) is consistently reduced, coinciding with the increasing protein resource demand from ribosomes. Meanwhile, nutrient limitation may induce resource recycling by upregulating protein resources within specific compartments (e.g., vacuole) to sustain stress adaptation. Importantly, our integrative analysis indicates that PMF from a few subcellular compartments (e.g., nucleus and ribosomes) can accurately predict yeast physiological parameters (e.g., specific growth rate, oxygen uptake rate), and a limited protein set (≥ 23) could be used to capture the variation in resource allocation across seven major subcellular compartments. Furthermore, our comparative analysis between Crabtree-positive and Crabtree-negative species across conditions illustrates that subcellular resource allocation could be shaped by multiple factors and the two species differ markedly in their robustness to environmental perturbations. In summary, the high-quality quantitative proteomic dataset for yeast species offers an unprecedented opportunity for understanding the general principles underlying subcellular resource allocation, laying foundations for precision engineering of cell factories in synthetic biology.

papers.title: Standards in systems and synthetic biology: status, developments, and tools in 2026.
papers.abstract: For over a decade, the Journal of Integrative Bioinformatics has published special issues providing updated specifications for standards in systems biology and synthetic biology. Beginning in 2024, the special issues expanded to include novel or refined tools that leverage these standards or play a key role in their implementation. The current special issue contains four updated specifications and two tools or libraries. In addition, this document functions as a comprehensive reference for all COMBINE standard specifications, ensuring researchers and practitioners can access the most up-to-date versions available in the field.

papers.title: SynBioFooDB: a comprehensive resource for synthetic biology-driven food biomanufacturing.
papers.abstract: Enabled by synthetic biology and metabolic engineering, microbial biomanufacturing is reshaping the production of food-related compounds by offering sustainable alternatives to resource-intensive extraction and conventional chemical synthesis. However, information linking food-related compounds to biosynthetic pathways and microbial biomanufacturing evidence remains fragmented across the literature and poorly represented in existing food-oriented resources, hindering cross-study comparison, evidence synthesis, and rational design of microbial production systems. Here, we present SynBioFooDB (https://synbiofoodb.biodesign.ac.cn/), a knowledgebase dedicated to synthetic biology-driven food biomanufacturing. SynBioFooDB integrates 74 237 food-related compounds with standardized chemical identities and annotations covering food occurrence, bioactivity, toxicity, and regulatory information. It further provides expert-curated biomanufacturing evidence for 1054 compounds from 5592 publications, linking microbial hosts, substrates, genetic modifications, and quantitative production metrics through structured and traceable records. The database also contains 2002 literature-reported biosynthetic pathways for 971 compounds, enabling comparison of alternative precursors, enzyme combinations, and pathway architectures. For compounds without literature-reported pathways, SynBioFooDB provides computationally predicted candidate pathways to facilitate pathway prioritization and experimental evaluation. By integrating compound-level context, biomanufacturing evidence, and biosynthetic pathway information, SynBioFooDB supports systematic exploration, comparison, and rational design of microbial production strategies for food-related compounds.

papers.title: Synthetic Whole-Cell Biosensor for Early Transplant Rejection Detection
papers.abstract: Abstract Early detection of transplant rejection remains a major unmet clinical need because histopathology is invasive, episodic, and subject to sampling error, whereas serum creatinine and other routine chemistries often rise only after injury is established [1–4]. Here we describe a synthetic whole-cell biosensor that converts rejection-associated urinary nucleic acid signatures into a quantifiable fluorescent output using engineered Escherichia coli Nissle 1917. papers.title: High-throughput protein interactome identifies LSD1 as a regulator of SARS-CoV-2 production through lysine demethylation of viral nucleocapsid protein.
papers.abstract: High-throughput identification and imaging of protein-protein interactions (PPIs) under physiological conditions remains a significant challenge. Concurrently, the SARS-CoV-2 nucleocapsid (N) protein, the most abundant viral protein, plays an essential role in viral production. To advance the understanding of viral mechanisms and support antiviral development, we developed the brightest and smallest near-infrared bimolecular fluorescence complementation (NIR-BiFC) system using split miRFP670nano3. By integrating this system with next-generation sequencing (NGS), we established NIR-BiFC-Seq for the high-throughput mapping of protein interactomes. Applying this method, we systematically investigated interactions between the SARS-CoV-2 N protein and host cellular proteins. Our findings reveal that lysine-specific demethylase-1 (LSD1) demethylates the N protein at lysine 233 (K233), thereby enhancing viral production through the potentiation of multiple N protein functions. These include N protein dimerization, interaction with Nsp12, binding to viral RNA, and liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS). Notably, inhibitors targeting the K233 site significantly suppressed SARS-CoV-2 production. This study establishes NIR-BiFC-Seq as a sensitive synthetic biology platform for interactome mapping and identifies LSD1-mediated regulatory mechanisms as promising targets for antiviral therapy.

papers.title: Programmable Engineered Living Vehicles as Autonomous Biofactories for Synergistic Osteomyelitis Management and Bone Regeneration.
papers.abstract: Conventional static biomaterials and synthetic nanomedicines struggle to penetrate recalcitrant biofilms and orchestrate tissue regeneration in deep-seated infections due to limited autonomous navigation and a lack of spatiotemporal responsiveness. Here, we conceptualize and develop a programmable engineered living vehicle (ELV) that functions as an autonomous biofactory for the synergistic management of drug-resistant osteomyelitis. Built upon a self-propelled Escherichia coli Nissle 1917 chassis with innate ecological dominance, these living biofactories are hierarchically equipped with environmental biosensors and logic-gated computing modules. Crucially, leveraging AlphaFold 3-guided molecular docking, we engineered multiscale thermo-responsive genetic logic circuits that enable precise, temperature-dependent biomanufacturing of bacteriolytic lysostaphin (LYS) and vasoactive intestinal peptide (VIP) (≥37°C), coupled with a fail-safe thermal self-destruct mechanism (≥42°C). Furthermore, surface-engineered (DSS) 6 peptides confer robust hydroxyapatite affinity, acting as a bone-homing navigation module. In a rat osteomyelitis model induced by methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA), intravenously deployed ELV biofactories autonomously navigate to the infected niche, actively penetrate biofilms, and outperform vancomycin in pathogen clearance. Concurrently, localized payload secretion reprograms the osteo-immune microenvironment, significantly accelerating bone repair. This work establishes a versatile paradigm for next-generation smart living therapeutics, bridging synthetic biology with micro-engineering to address complex clinical challenges.

enrichment.titleZh: 可编程工程活体载体：用于骨髓炎协同治疗与骨再生的自主生物工厂
enrichment.abstractZh: 传统静态生物材料和合成纳米药物缺少自主导航及对时空变化的响应能力，因而难以穿透顽固生物膜并在深部感染中协调组织再生。本研究提出并构建了可编程工程活体载体（ELV），作为自主生物工厂协同应对耐药性骨髓炎。该体系以具有自主运动能力和固有生态竞争优势的大肠杆菌 Nissle 1917 为底盘，分层配置环境生物传感器和逻辑门计算模块。借助 AlphaFold 3 指导的分子对接，研究者设计了多尺度温度响应遗传逻辑电路，使其在温度≥37°C时按温度条件生产溶葡萄球菌酶（LYS）和血管活性肠肽（VIP），同时在温度≥42°C时触发热自毁保险机制。表面工程化的 (DSS)6 肽赋予载体较强的羟基磷灰石亲和力，发挥骨组织归巢导航作用。在耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）诱导的大鼠骨髓炎模型中，经静脉给药的 ELV 可自主到达感染部位、主动穿透生物膜，其病原菌清除效果优于万古霉素。局部释放的功能产物还可重塑骨免疫微环境，显著促进骨修复。作者认为，这项工作将合成生物学与微工程结合，为智能活体治疗提供了可拓展的设计范式。

papers.title: Small genomes, big lessons: What viruses teach us about structure-based riboregulation.
papers.abstract: RNA viruses encode multiple layers of information within a single molecule, which functions simultaneously as a template for protein synthesis and as a structured regulatory RNA. These structures control key aspects of viral gene expression, govern host interactions, and mediate immune evasion. Although the prevalence of RNA structure in viral genomes is now well established, only recently have functional and mechanistic studies begun to uncover how these elements act as regulatory modules that shape infection outcomes. With their compact genomes and experimentally tractable life cycles, RNA viruses represent powerful model systems for uncovering the fundamental building blocks of riboregulation and illuminating principles of gene control conserved across eukaryotes. Here, we review current mechanistic understanding of RNA structure-based regulation across diverse viral families and draw parallels to structure-mediated gene control in eukaryotic transcriptomes, highlighting RNA structure as a central regulatory layer in gene expression with broad therapeutic and synthetic biology potential.
papers.authors: Hann T, Jang H, Sung YC, Guh CL, Hiers NM, Tsao LH, Luo M, Pyle AM.

papers.title: From cell factories to photobiocatalysts: reengineering cyanobacteria for solar-driven chemical manufacturing.
papers.abstract: To achieve more sustainable, light-powered chemical manufacturing, cyanobacterial engineering is expanding from conventional carbon-accumulating "cell factories" toward the complementary use of cyanobacteria as "whole-cell photobiocatalysts." This review critically examines this conceptual extension. By shifting the engineering focus from carbon-centric biosynthesis to electron- and energy-coupled catalysis, this emerging approach partially decouples target-product formation from the de novo assembly of CO 2 -derived carbon skeletons. Instead, it exploits photosynthetically generated reducing equivalents and ATP to support redox and energy-dependent enzymatic transformations, thereby reducing dependence on external cofactor- or energy-regeneration systems. We outline a multidimensional engineering framework that integrates carbon-flux redirection ("push"), coupling to photosynthetically generated reducing equivalents and ATP ("drive"), and product-removal-driven "pull" through secretion, volatilization, or in situ extraction. We further highlight advances in light-tolerant and stress-robust cyanobacterial chassis, together with emerging process strategies based on attached-growth and biofilm photobioreactors. We also critically consider genetic instability, variable enzyme-coupling efficiency, and scale-dependent light and mass-transfer limitations. Finally, we discuss the biophysical and energetic limits of light-to-chemical conversion, competition for reducing power, the largely conceptual potential of temporally decoupled light harvesting and dark-phase catalysis, and the need to select economically viable target products using rigorous techno-economic and life-cycle analyses. Collectively, this review provides conceptual and practical guidance for developing sustainable photosynthetic biomanufacturing platforms.
papers.authors: Pan K, Liu D, Chen L, Sun T, Zhang W.

enrichment.titleZh: 从细胞工厂到光生物催化剂：重构蓝细菌以实现太阳能驱动的化学品制造
enrichment.abstractZh: 为实现更可持续的光驱动化学品制造，蓝细菌工程正从传统的碳积累型“细胞工厂”拓展至互补的“全细胞光生物催化剂”应用。本综述对这一概念拓展进行了批判性分析。通过将工程重点从以碳为中心的生物合成转向电子和能量耦合的催化，这种新方式可在一定程度上将目标产物形成与 CO₂ 来源碳骨架的从头组装解耦，而利用光合作用产生的还原当量和 ATP，支持依赖氧化还原反应或能量的酶促转化，减少对外源辅因子或能量再生体系的依赖。文章提出多维工程框架，将碳通量重定向的“推力”、光合还原当量与 ATP 耦合的“驱动力”，以及通过分泌、挥发或原位提取移除产物形成的“拉力”相结合。综述还介绍了耐光、抗胁迫蓝细菌底盘，以及附着生长和生物膜光生物反应器等工艺策略，并分析遗传不稳定、酶耦合效率变化，以及规模放大时的光照和传质限制。最后，文章讨论光到化学能转化的生物物理及能量极限、还原力竞争、在时间上分离光捕获与暗期催化这一主要仍处于概念阶段的潜力，以及通过严格技术经济和生命周期分析选择经济可行产品的必要性，为可持续光合生物制造提供概念和实践指导。

papers.title: Sustainable biomanufacturing of rare ginsenosides from Panax notoginseng : a critical review.
papers.abstract: Rare ginsenosides (e.g. C-K, Rg3, Rh2) hold therapeutic promise but are severely constrained by low natural abundance. This review critically examines the entire biomanufacturing pipeline from green extraction to multi-modal conversion and de novo biosynthesis. Unlike previous reviews focusing on single technologies, this work systematically evaluates physical, chemical, and biological strategies and proposes an integrated upstream-midstream-downstream framework. Physical and chemical conversion methods can produce rare ginsenosides from abundant common precursors in Panax notoginseng , yet suffer from harsh conditions, poor selectivity, and C-20 epimeric mixtures. Biotransformation offers high regioselectivity, mild conditions, and retention of the desired 20(S)-configuration. However, distinct challenges exist such as microbial whole-cell fermentation suffers from complex metabolic networks, long cycles, and difficult separation, while enzymatic catalysis faces high enzyme costs, poor stability, and single-step limitations. Notably, while de novo biosynthesis draws upon key enzyme genes from Panax notoginseng to theoretically eliminate plant dependence, facing metabolic burden, low titers, and high costs, remain far from industrial viability. We highlight biocatalytic strengths including enzyme-mediated precise deglycosylation and recent breakthroughs in directed enzyme engineering for single products. From a techno-economic perspective, enzymatic conversion remains the most competitive route for producing rare ginsenosides at present, whereas de novo biosynthesis currently lacks the efficiency and economic feasibility to replace it.
papers.authors: Liang D, Tian H, Zhao H, Bu R, Huang W, Li X, Gao W.

enrichment.titleZh: 三七稀有人参皂苷的可持续生物制造：批判性综述
enrichment.abstractZh: 稀有人参皂苷（如 C-K、Rg3 和 Rh2）具有治疗开发潜力，但其天然含量低，限制了供应。本综述系统评估从绿色提取、多模式转化到从头生物合成的完整制造流程，并提出整合上游、中游和下游的框架。物理和化学转化可利用三七中丰富的常见前体制备稀有人参皂苷，但存在条件苛刻、选择性差及产生 C-20 差向异构体混合物等问题。生物转化具有区域选择性高、条件温和以及保留目标 20(S) 构型的优势，但微生物全细胞发酵面临代谢网络复杂、周期长和分离困难等挑战，酶催化则受酶成本高、稳定性差和单步反应限制。利用三七关键酶基因的从头生物合成理论上可消除对植物原料的依赖，但仍受代谢负担、产量低和成本高等因素制约，距离工业可行性较远。文章强调酶介导精准脱糖基化及定向酶工程在单一产物制备中的进展。从技术经济角度看，作者认为酶法转化目前仍是生产稀有人参皂苷最具竞争力的路线，而从头生物合成尚不具备替代它的效率和经济可行性。

papers.title: The historical evolution of CHO cell line development for biologics production: 60 years and still counting.
papers.abstract: Chinese Hamster Ovary (CHO) cells have played a central role in the production of therapeutic proteins since their initial isolation in the 1950s. Over the decades, scientific innovations have transformed CHO cells into the powerhouse of the biopharmaceutical industry. From rudimentary culture conditions and random integration of transgenes into the host genome, to synthetic biology, genetic engineering, high-performing chemically defined media, targeted transgene integration and AI-driven cell line development strategies, each decade has introduced transformative tools, knowledge, and insights to improve CHO cell line development and characterization processes. This review outlines the chronological history of the CHO cell line development process, decade by decade, highlighting central milestones and innovations, technological breakthroughs, and the role of key innovative steps that have enabled modern cell line development workflows and ultimately the industrial-scale manufacturing of biologics.
papers.authors: Fieder J, Schneider S, Fischer S.

enrichment.titleZh: 生物制品生产用 CHO 细胞系开发的历史演进：六十年历程仍在继续
enrichment.abstractZh: 自20世纪50年代首次分离以来，中国仓鼠卵巢（CHO）细胞一直在治疗性蛋白生产中发挥核心作用。数十年来，科学创新使 CHO 细胞成为生物制药工业的主要生产平台。从简陋的培养条件和外源基因在宿主基因组中的随机整合，到合成生物学、基因工程、高性能化学成分限定培养基、外源基因定点整合，以及人工智能驱动的细胞系开发策略，每个年代都带来了改变 CHO 细胞系开发与表征流程的工具、知识和认识。本综述按年代梳理 CHO 细胞系开发的历史，突出关键里程碑、创新和技术突破，以及推动现代细胞系开发流程并最终实现生物制品工业规模制造的重要步骤。

papers.title: Transglycosidases from aspergillus genus and their applications in food processing: Advances in enzyme mining and smart biocatalysis.
papers.abstract: Transglycosidases (TGs) constitute a family of glycoside hydrolases that perform glycosyl transfer via intra- and intermolecular substitution. A. niger, A. oryzae, and other Aspergillus strains represent the major industrial sources of TGs, which are widely applied in food processing. However, prominent bottlenecks still restrict the optimization of enzyme performance, industrial adaptation, and the construction of synergistic catalytic systems. This comprehensive review expounds the application potential of Aspergillus-derived TGs in food processing, analyzes the scientific basis of artificial intelligence (AI) regulation on enzyme catalytic performance, systematically summarizes the molecular modification and multi-enzyme synergistic mechanisms, and illustrates their application effects in the fields of prebiotic oligosaccharides, dairy products, brewing, and baking. Furthermore, it promotes the in-depth integration of AI and food biomanufacturing, and advances the high-quality development of the green functional food processing industry, showing sustainable and bright prospects in smart bioprocessing and big-health food research.
papers.authors: Zhu W, Tang J, Song X, Jia X, Deng W, Chen X, Tang M, Liu X, Shi H, Zhou J, Tan Z.

enrichment.titleZh: 曲霉属转糖苷酶及其在食品加工中的应用：酶挖掘与智能生物催化进展
enrichment.abstractZh: 转糖苷酶（TGs）属于糖苷水解酶家族，可通过分子内或分子间取代完成糖基转移。黑曲霉、米曲霉及其他曲霉菌株是工业转糖苷酶的主要来源，这类酶广泛应用于食品加工。不过，酶性能优化、工业适应及协同催化体系构建仍受到明显瓶颈制约。本综述阐述曲霉来源转糖苷酶在食品加工中的应用潜力，分析利用人工智能调控酶催化性能的科学依据，系统总结分子改造和多酶协同机制，并介绍其在益生元低聚糖、乳制品、酿造和烘焙等领域的应用效果。文章进一步讨论人工智能与食品生物制造的融合，以及绿色功能食品加工、智能生物加工和大健康食品研究的发展前景。

papers.title: Microbial synthesis of short-chain sophorolipid esters using yeasts of the Starmerella clade.
papers.abstract: Acetylated sophorolipid (SL) esters exhibit surface-active as well as bioactive properties. Their synthesis requires a three-step route comprising microbial production of the SL lactone followed by chemical transesterification and enzymatic re-acetylation. Here, a direct microbial synthesis of SL esters was investigated using three-component feeding of glucose, oleic acid and a wide variety of alcohols. Straight-chain primary alcohols with chain lengths of C3-C12 impaired SL production of Starmerella bombicola severely, whereas toxicity of short-chain primary, secondary and branched-chain alcohols was significantly lower, and total SL production of up to 60 g l -1 was obtained in initial shake-flask cultures. Besides lactonic, acidic and bolaform SLs, acetylated SL esters were detected in small quantities in the fermentation broth. Upon continuous alcohol feeding the SL ester fraction could be increased to 10-40 g l -1 of methyl, ethyl, isopropyl and isobutyl SL esters under optimized conditions. Following chromatographic purification, the ester structures were verified by LC-MS and NMR spectroscopy. The synthesis of the isopropyl SL ester was scaled up successfully to a 2 l bioreactor, yielding 100 g l -1 total SL including 30 g l -1 of the isopropyl ester. To elucidate the SL ester formation capabilities within the Starmerella clade, five additional species were screened. SL synthesis was shown for the first time with S. caucasica and S. davenportii. With all strains, including ω-hydroxylating open-chain SL producing S. kuoi and S. batistae, SL ester formation was detected. Thus, the ability for SL ester synthesis seems to be ubiquitous among SL producing Starmerella strains.
papers.authors: Banmann E, Aksoy EM, Schörken U.

enrichment.titleZh: 利用 Starmerella 类群酵母进行短链槐糖脂酯的微生物合成
enrichment.abstractZh: 乙酰化槐糖脂（SL）酯兼具表面活性与生物活性。传统合成需要依次进行槐糖脂内酯的微生物生产、化学转酯和酶促再乙酰化。本研究使用葡萄糖、油酸和多种醇三组分供料，探索槐糖脂酯的直接微生物合成。碳链长度为 C3—C12 的直链伯醇严重抑制 Starmerella bombicola 生产槐糖脂；短链伯醇、仲醇及支链醇的毒性则明显较低，初始摇瓶培养中总槐糖脂浓度最高可达60 g/L。发酵液中除内酯型、酸型及双头型槐糖脂外，还检测到少量乙酰化槐糖脂酯。通过持续供醇，在优化条件下，甲酯、乙酯、异丙酯和异丁酯型槐糖脂的浓度可提高至10—40 g/L。经色谱纯化后，研究者通过 LC-MS 和核磁共振验证了酯结构。异丙基槐糖脂酯的合成成功放大至2 L生物反应器，总槐糖脂达到100 g/L，其中异丙酯为30 g/L。为考察 Starmerella 类群的酯合成能力，研究者还筛选了另外5个物种，首次证明 S. caucasica 和 S. davenportii 可合成槐糖脂。包括产生 ω-羟基化开链槐糖脂的 S. kuoi 与 S. batistae 在内，所有菌株均检测到酯形成，提示这种能力可能普遍存在于产生槐糖脂的 Starmerella 菌株中。

papers.title: Synthetic biology for heritable viral disease resistance in livestock.
papers.abstract: Synthetic biology is rapidly expanding the strategies available to engineer disease resistance in livestock. Genome editing of host factors required for pathogen entry or replication has generated complete or partial resistance in pigs, cattle, and chickens, culminating in the first regulatory approvals of PRRSV-resistant pigs. Another frontier is emerging in which synthetic antiviral circuits detect and suppress infection through programmable molecular responses. Precision editing tools, including base and prime editors, may enable resistance through smaller and more targeted genomic changes, while organoid and stem cell-derived cell cultures are accelerating pre-animal validation. This review examines recent advances in host-factor engineering, synthetic antiviral systems, and enabling platforms, and considers the challenges of commercial dissemination, regulation, and public acceptance. Together, these developments position engineered resistance as a potentially important component of integrated livestock disease control.
papers.authors: Beaton BP, Rice E.

enrichment.titleZh: 用于家畜可遗传病毒病抗性的合成生物学
enrichment.abstractZh: 合成生物学正迅速扩展家畜抗病性工程的可用策略。通过编辑病原体进入或复制所必需的宿主因子，研究者已在猪、牛和鸡中获得完全或部分抗性，并推动了抗猪繁殖与呼吸综合征病毒（PRRSV）猪的首批监管批准。另一个新方向是利用合成抗病毒电路，通过可编程分子响应检测并抑制感染。包括碱基编辑和先导编辑在内的精准编辑工具，有望以更小、更具靶向性的基因组改动实现抗性；类器官及干细胞来源培养体系则在加速动物试验前验证。本综述总结宿主因子工程、合成抗病毒系统和相关支撑平台的进展，并讨论商业推广、监管和公众接受度等挑战。作者认为，这些进展使工程化抗性有望成为家畜疾病综合控制的重要组成部分。

papers.title: A First-Generation Integrated Continuous Bioprocessing Facility: Conceptual Design and Economic Analysis.
papers.abstract: We present a tool to help identify and develop shared goals for collaboration on technologies, standards, and regulatory understanding that will be needed to enable the biopharmaceutical factories the industry will need in the next five years. That tool is a publicly available design and economic analysis of a state-of-the-art commercial scale continuous biomanufacturing facility. Using current technology, equipment, quality and regulatory expectations, this design is described as a reference point against which new technology can be compared, and to illustrate the cost advantages of integrated continuous biomanufacturing. The facility can produce anywhere between 225kg to 3,600kg of mAb per year, at a capital cost of approximately $210 million. This compares to a traditional 6x15kL SS facility, which can produce about 170% more but has a capital cost more than 5 times higher. A 20-year net present cost analysis showed that the continuous facility with bioreactor volumetric productivity of 5 g/L bioreactor/day was favorable to the traditional 15kL six-pack at a titer of 10 g/L by half a billion to over a billion dollars, even at production rates up to 14,000 kg/yr.
papers.authors: Szuszkiewicz R, Johnson J, Edmunds C, Gravallese S, Hamilton K, Horowski B, Lee K, Partopour B, Piombino T, Torres J, Erickson J.
papers.journal: PDA journal of pharmaceutical science and technology

enrichment.titleZh: 第一代集成连续生物加工设施：概念设计与经济分析
enrichment.abstractZh: 本研究提出一个工具，帮助行业就未来五年生物制药工厂所需的技术、标准和监管认识建立共同目标。该工具是一套公开可获取的、先进商业规模连续生物制造设施的设计与经济分析。设计基于当前技术、设备、质量和监管要求，可作为比较新技术的参照，并展示集成连续生物制造的成本优势。该设施每年可生产225—3600 kg单克隆抗体，资本成本约2.1亿美元。相比之下，传统的6台15 kL不锈钢生物反应器设施虽然产能约高出170%，但资本成本超过其5倍。20年净现值成本分析表明，在连续设施的反应器体积生产强度为5 g/L反应器/天、传统六台15 kL设施的滴度为10 g/L时，即使年产量高达14000 kg，连续设施仍可获得约5亿至超过10亿美元的成本优势。

papers.title: Cordyceps as a multitarget therapeutic platform: biology, bioactive metabolites, and translational challenges.
papers.abstract: Cordyceps-related fungi have garnered global attention as multifunctional therapeutic resources owing to their exclusive entomopathogenic biology, remarkable metabolic diversity, and expanding pharmaceutical bearing. Recent taxonomic revisions determined by molecular phylogenetics have redefined the traditional notion of Cordyceps, revealing distinct evolutionary lineages with species-specific metabolite profiles and biological functions. This review provides a complete and evidence-based synthesis of the taxonomy, ecology, host interactions, chemical composition, biosynthetic pathways, pharmacological activities, and translational prospects of chief medicinal species, including Ophiocordyceps sinensis, Cordyceps militaris, Cordyceps cicadae, and related taxa. Particular emphasis is placed on cordycepin, the signature bioactive nucleoside, and its integration with broader metabolite networks encompassing polysaccharides, sterols, peptides, and secondary metabolites. Current evidence demonstrates that Cordyceps-derived compounds influence multiple interconnected signaling pathways, including AMPK, PI3K/Akt/mTOR, NF-κB, MAPK, and oxidative stress-response networks, thereby contributing to immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, anticancer, neuroprotective, and metabolic regulatory effects. The review further reviews recent advances in genomics, transcriptomics, metabolomics, biosynthetic gene-cluster analysis, synthetic biology, metabolic engineering, and exactness fermentation technologies that are redesigning Cordyceps research and industrial production. Critical challenges including species authentication, chemical standardization, pharmacokinetic limitations, product reproducibility, safety evaluation, regulatory requirements, and inadequate clinical validation are also discussed. By integrating biological identity, metabolite biosynthesis, molecular mechanisms, and technological innovation within a translational framework, this review positions Cordyceps as a promising systems-level platform for future therapeutics, functional foods, and precision mycotherapy.
papers.authors: Chaudhary A, Maurya S, Ehsan S, Choure K, Singh MP.

enrichment.titleZh: 虫草相关真菌作为多靶点治疗平台：生物学、活性代谢物与转化挑战
enrichment.abstractZh: 虫草相关真菌因独特的昆虫病原生物学、丰富的代谢多样性及不断拓展的药用关联，受到全球关注。基于分子系统发育的近期分类修订重新界定了传统虫草概念，揭示了具有物种特异性代谢物谱和生物功能的不同演化谱系。本综述基于现有证据，综合讨论冬虫夏草、蛹虫草、蝉花及相关类群的分类、生态、宿主相互作用、化学组成、生物合成途径、药理活性及转化前景，重点关注标志性活性核苷虫草素，以及它与多糖、甾醇、肽类和次级代谢物网络的联系。现有证据提示，虫草来源化合物可影响 AMPK、PI3K/Akt/mTOR、NF-κB、MAPK 和氧化应激反应等相互关联的通路，从而产生免疫调节、抗炎、抗微生物、抗癌、神经保护及代谢调节作用。文章还总结基因组学、转录组学、代谢组学、生物合成基因簇分析、合成生物学、代谢工程和精准发酵等技术进展，并讨论物种鉴定、化学标准化、药代动力学限制、产品重复性、安全评价、监管要求及临床验证不足等问题。作者在转化框架下整合生物学身份、代谢物合成、分子机制及技术创新，探讨虫草相关真菌在未来治疗、功能食品与精准真菌治疗中的平台潜力。

papers.title: Development of isopentenol utilization pathway based on cell-free metabolic engineering and its application in multienzyme cascades synthesis.
papers.abstract: Conventional microbial biosynthetic pathways for isoprenoid often require intricate metabolic balancing and multigene regulation, which are not only time-consuming but also prone to interference from host cellular metabolism and feedback inhibition by toxic intermediate metabolites or end-products. In this study, we developed a novel cell-free multienzyme catalytic system for the synthesis of lycopene, a representative isoprenoid. By integrating the isopentenol utilization pathway with cell-free metabolic engineering strategies, the system eliminates the need for complex in vivo genetic modifications and avoids inherent cellular metabolic interference. The in vitro reaction employs seven enzymes directly, enabling rapid and efficient lycopene production without relying on costly substrates isopentenyl pyrophosphate (IPP) and dimethylallyl pyrophosphate (DMAPP). The optimized cell-free reaction mixture consisted of isoprenol and prenol (3:1 molar ratio, 15 mM), seven key enzymes (each at a concentration of 0.6 mg/mL), 8 mM Mg 2 + , 1 mM NAD, 1 mM ATP, 1 mM CoA, and 0.05% (w/v) Tween 20 in 30 mM Bis-Tris buffer (pH 6.5). After incubation at 30 °C for 20 h, the lycopene titer reached 128.04 mg/L. Further in vivo validation achieved a final lycopene titer of 270.0 mg/L. This novel approach offers a promising alternative strategy to overcome common challenges associated with the construction and regulation of complex natural isoprenoid biosynthetic pathways.
papers.authors: Xing H, Zou Y, Yuan Y, Shen Q, Xu F, Tan Y, Lu X, Sun M, Xu X.

papers.title: From ecosystem engineering to living computers: integrating dual-paradigm bacterial therapeutics for solid tumor microenvironment reprogramming.
papers.abstract: Recent advances in tumor microbiome biology and synthetic biology have made bacteria attractive therapeutic agents capable of reprogramming tumor-associated microbial ecosystems and serving as programmable living systems in solid tumors. In this review, we construct a dual-paradigm framework combining engineered bacterial therapeutics and ecosystem editing. In the first paradigm, phage-mediated targeting, competitive displacement, and metabolic reprogramming are used to alter tumor-associated microbial communities. In the second paradigm, engineered bacteria are equipped with environmental sensors, genetic logic circuits, and therapeutic payloads. We discuss the mechanistic interplay of these strategies in terms of ecological niche formation, bacterial colonization, immune and metabolic remodeling, and microbiome-host feedback. Clinical experience still varies across platforms due to differences in bacterial strain, attenuation, route of administration, tumor biology, treatment context, and patient characteristics. Major translational challenges include biocontainment, genetic stability, manufacturing and potency control, predictive biomarker validation, and product-specific regulatory requirements. We propose an additional hypothesis-generating framework for patient stratification and adaptive treatment monitoring. These concepts together provide a structured framework for exploring bacterial therapeutics as components of precision oncology, while highlighting the need for prospective clinical validation.
papers.authors: Elmetwalli A, Algehainy NA, Altemani FH, Alanazi MA, Altemani AH.

enrichment.titleZh: 从生态系统工程到活体计算机：整合双范式细菌疗法以重塑实体瘤微环境
enrichment.abstractZh: 肿瘤微生物组与合成生物学的进展，使细菌成为既能重塑肿瘤相关微生物生态，又能充当可编程活体系统的候选治疗载体。本综述构建了结合工程细菌疗法与生态系统编辑的双范式框架。第一种范式通过噬菌体介导的靶向作用、竞争性替代和代谢重编程改变肿瘤相关微生物群落；第二种范式则为工程细菌配置环境传感器、遗传逻辑电路和治疗载荷。文章从生态位形成、细菌定植、免疫及代谢重塑，以及微生物组—宿主反馈等方面讨论两类策略的机制联系。不同平台的临床经验仍因菌株、减毒方式、给药途径、肿瘤生物学、治疗背景和患者特征而异。主要转化挑战包括生物遏制、遗传稳定性、制造及效力控制、预测性生物标志物验证和产品特异性监管要求。作者还提出用于形成患者分层与适应性治疗监测假设的框架，为探索精准肿瘤治疗中的细菌疗法提供结构化思路，同时强调需要前瞻性临床验证。

papers.title: Metabolic engineering of Yarrowia lipolytica for higher fatty alcohol production
papers.abstract: Fatty alcohols are versatile chemicals with growing demand across a broad range of industries, yet conventional production methods pose environmental challenges. Microbial biosynthesis offers a promising alternative, if hosts can be engineered to achieve high product titers. The industrially relevant oleaginous yeast Yarrowia lipolytica is well suited to this challenge because of its natural capacity for lipid metabolism. Here, we engineered Y. lipolytica W29 for fatty alcohol production by disrupting pathways involved in lipogenesis and fatty alcohol oxidation, identifying fatty alcohol oxidation as a major constraint on product accumulation. Initial engineering yielded fatty alcohol titers of 2.5 g/L from 40 g/L glucose. Subsequent optimization of media supplements and nutrient concentrations, combined with deletion of the citrate transporter CEX1 and addition of 1% Tergitol to the extractive culture medium, increased titers to 10.9 g/L in shake flasks with 80 g/L glucose and a carbon-to-nitrogen ratio of 60. Scaling the process to fed-batch bioreactor cultivation further increased titers to 19.4 g/L. These results demonstrate that combining metabolic engineering with medium and process optimization enables high-titer fatty alcohol production in Y. lipolytica.
papers.authors: Joseph E, Eminli F, Tohidifar P, Jagtap SS, Rao CV.

enrichment.titleZh: 通过代谢工程提高解脂耶氏酵母的脂肪醇产量
enrichment.abstractZh: 脂肪醇是多种行业需求不断增长的通用化学品，但传统生产方式带来环境问题。如果能通过宿主工程实现高滴度，微生物合成可成为有前景的替代方案。具有工业应用价值的产油酵母解脂耶氏酵母具备天然脂质代谢能力，适合承担这一任务。本研究改造 Yarrowia lipolytica W29，通过破坏脂质合成及脂肪醇氧化相关途径，确定脂肪醇氧化是限制产物积累的主要因素。初步改造后，以40 g/L葡萄糖为底物，脂肪醇滴度达到2.5 g/L。随后优化培养基添加物和营养浓度，同时删除柠檬酸转运蛋白基因 CEX1，并在萃取培养基中加入1% Tergitol，使摇瓶培养在80 g/L葡萄糖、碳氮比60的条件下达到10.9 g/L。放大至补料分批生物反应器后，滴度进一步提高至19.4 g/L。这些结果表明，将代谢工程与培养基及工艺优化相结合，可实现解脂耶氏酵母的高滴度脂肪醇生产。

papers.title: Microbial Ethylene Glycol Metabolism: Pathways, Metabolic Engineering, and PET Upcycling.
papers.abstract: Ethylene glycol (EG) is an attractive non-sugar carbon source because it can be obtained from petrochemical routes, renewable production platforms, and the depolymerization of polyethylene terephthalate (PET), thereby linking plastic upcycling with sustainable biomanufacturing. In recent years, substantial progress has been made in elucidating EG catabolism, including the initial oxidation of EG, native glyoxylate assimilation pathways, synthetic route design, and chassis engineering. Nevertheless, efficient and robust EG bioconversion is still limited by unfavorable thermodynamics, low catalytic efficiency, intermediate toxicity, and pathway-host incompatibility. In this Review, we summarize recent advances in three interconnected areas: the oxidation of EG to glycolaldehyde and its downstream processing; glyoxylate-centered native assimilation networks and their integration with central carbon metabolism; and synthetic pathways designed to improve carbon conservation and redirect carbon flux toward acetyl-CoA, central metabolites, and target products. We compare the tartronate semialdehyde pathway with the β-hydroxyaspartate cycle, discuss key design principles for synthetic modules, and highlight recent progress in chassis engineering, regulatory rewiring, and the direct conversion of PET hydrolysates. We further emphasize the ongoing transition from single-substrate EG utilization to integrated PET upcycling, in which mixed-monomer co-utilization, impurity tolerance, and aldehyde detoxification have emerged as major engineering targets. Overall, EG is becoming a promising platform substrate for connecting plastic waste recycling with green biomanufacturing, although further advances in enzyme discovery, pathway optimization, and pathway-host matching are still required.
papers.authors: Qian J, Wang P, Wang W, Li J, Zhang X, Zhu X, Chen M, Bi C, Zhang X.

enrichment.titleZh: 微生物乙二醇代谢：途径、代谢工程与 PET 升级再造
enrichment.abstractZh: 乙二醇（EG）可来源于石化路线、可再生生产平台及聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯（PET）的解聚，因此是一种连接塑料升级再造与可持续生物制造的有吸引力的非糖碳源。近年来，对乙二醇分解代谢的认识已取得较大进展，包括初始氧化、天然乙醛酸同化、合成途径设计和底盘工程。然而，不利的热力学、低催化效率、中间体毒性及途径与宿主不兼容，仍限制其高效稳健转化。本综述总结三个相互联系的方面：乙二醇氧化为乙醇醛及其后续转化；以乙醛酸为中心的天然同化网络及其与中心碳代谢的整合；旨在提高碳保留并将通量导向乙酰辅酶A、中心代谢物和目标产物的合成途径。文章比较羟基丙二酸半醛途径与 β-羟基天冬氨酸循环，讨论合成模块的设计原则，并介绍底盘工程、调控重构及 PET 水解产物直接转化的进展。文章强调该领域正从单一乙二醇利用转向集成 PET 升级再造，混合单体共利用、杂质耐受和醛解毒已成为主要工程目标。总体而言，乙二醇正成为连接塑料回收与绿色生物制造的有前景的平台底物，但仍需推进酶发现、途径优化及途径—宿主匹配。

papers.title: Neutral Morphological Masking: Constructive Neutral Evolution of Chiral Scaffolds for Information-Maintaining Artificial Cells
papers.abstract: Abstract A minimal synthetic cell that completes a full replication–growth–division cycle still demonstrates nothing about self-maintenance unless it also carries a state variable that can degrade under a genuine environmental stress and be actively defended. Our earlier proposal (Sandler, 2026b) specified such a module — chiral order Uχ as a programmable memory, D-glucose glycation as a stress channel, and circular dichroism (CD) as a sensor — but treated the robustness that protects Uχ as a static, hand-designed surface property, u_s. That is an adaptationist assumption dressed as an engineering parameter, and it is also why the initial submission read as disconnected from current artificial-life research: a designed robustness knob does not need to cite the literature on how robustness actually arises in living systems. This revision addresses both problems by fusing the chiral-order module with Constructive Neutral Evolution (CNE), the framework in which biological complexity accumulates through selectively neutral steps rather than adaptive design (Stoltzfus, 1999), and specifically with the interlocking-masking mechanism recently formalized for multi-subunit complexes in the Quandary Den artificial-life model (Walsh, 2026). In the synthesized framework, random neutral mutations introduce structural protrusions in one subunit of a multi-subunit chiral scaffold; complementary recesses that neutrally arise in partner subunits mask these protrusions to preserve packing order, and the accumulated interlocking geometry incidentally occludes the scaffold's glycation-vulnerable amine sites. Geometric surface uniformity, u_s, is therefore reframed as an emergent, unselected byproduct of a masking ratchet rather than a design input. We give the resulting multi-subunit dynamical system, retain the original module's mechanistic lattice Monte Carlo and site-diluted XY-model machinery as validation of the underlying stress–state–repair physics, and add a new toy evolutionary simulation demonstrating the internal consequences of the proposed masking rules: a one-directional ratchet in interlocking complexity, an incidental decline in the emergent glycation-rate constant, and accidental cross-protection against a novel stress shock in lineages that accumulated complexity under no direct selection for glycation resistance. We situate the proposal explicitly against current artificial-life and synthetic-biology literature on self-maintaining and homeostatic artificial cells, give an expanded, falsifiable prediction set, and lay out a staged validation roadmap.
papers.authors: Sandler L.

enrichment.titleZh: 中性形态遮蔽：用于维持信息的人工细胞手性支架的建构性中性演化
enrichment.abstractZh: 即使最小合成细胞能够完成复制—生长—分裂全周期，也不足以证明其具有自我维持能力，除非它还携带一种会在真实环境胁迫下退化、并能受到主动保护的状态变量。作者此前的方案将手性有序度 Uχ 作为可编程记忆、D-葡萄糖糖基化作为胁迫通道、圆二色性（CD）作为传感器，但把保护 Uχ 的稳健性视为静态、人工设计的表面属性 u_s。本文通过将手性有序模块与建构性中性演化（CNE）整合来修订这一假设；CNE认为生物复杂性可通过选择中性的步骤积累，而非只能依赖适应性设计。具体采用近期在 Quandary Den 人工生命模型中形式化的互锁遮蔽机制：随机中性突变使多亚基手性支架中的某亚基产生结构突起，其他亚基中中性出现的互补凹槽遮蔽突起、维持堆积有序；积累的互锁几何形态附带遮挡易受糖基化影响的胺基位点。因此，表面几何均一性 u_s 被重新解释为遮蔽棘轮产生的、未经直接选择的涌现副产物，而不是设计输入。作者给出多亚基动力学系统，保留原模块的机制性晶格蒙特卡洛及位点稀释 XY 模型，用于验证胁迫—状态—修复的基础物理过程，并新增简化演化模拟，展示所提遮蔽规则的内部后果：互锁复杂性的单向增加、涌现糖基化速率常数的附带下降，以及未直接经历抗糖基化选择的谱系对新胁迫的偶然交叉保护。文章将方案置于自我维持和稳态人工细胞研究的背景中，扩展可证伪预测，并提出分阶段验证路线。

papers.title: Progress and perspectives in nitrogenase engineering in plants and yeast.
papers.abstract: Crop productivity relies on synthetic nitrogen fertilizers, which entail significant economic and environmental costs. Engineering crop plants to produce nitrogenase allowing them to acquire nitrogen from the atmosphere offers a transformative approach to sustainable agriculture. However, engineering the nitrogenase pathway into eukaryotic cells poses significant challenges due to the enzyme metal clusters, high energy demands, and extreme sensitivity to oxygen. This review summarizes recent advances in nitrogenase engineering in yeast and plants. Progress has been made using a stepwise modular approach and a functional validation pipeline for core and ancillary nitrogenase proteins. Key milestones include recovery of NifH with in vitro activity from mitochondria and chloroplasts, production of NifB that is active upon isolation or after in vitro cluster reconstitution, production of NifB-co in yeast mitochondria, in vitro FeMo-co biosynthesis using proteins purified from yeast mitochondria, and recovery of nitrogenase components from transgenic rice with activity demonstrated in vitro. Complete nitrogenase activity in engineered yeast or plants has not yet been demonstrated. We discuss the importance of organelle targeting, the exploitation of natural diversity and engineered proteins, and synthetic biology tools for the assembly of multigene pathways. Finally, we present the main remaining obstacles, such as the assembly of functional NifDK in plants, integration with host metabolism and coordinated regulation, and we outline the prospects for the development of nitrogen-fixing crops.
papers.authors: Paganelli Á, Curatti L, González-Guerrero M, Burén S, Rubio LM.

enrichment.titleZh: 植物与酵母固氮酶工程的进展与展望
enrichment.abstractZh: 作物生产依赖合成氮肥，带来较大的经济与环境成本。通过工程化使作物产生固氮酶、直接利用大气氮，为可持续农业提供了潜在的变革性途径。但固氮酶包含金属簇、能量需求高且对氧极度敏感，因此将其途径导入真核细胞面临重大挑战。本综述总结酵母和植物固氮酶工程的进展，重点介绍针对核心及辅助固氮酶蛋白的逐步模块化构建与功能验证流程。关键里程碑包括：从线粒体和叶绿体获得具有体外活性的 NifH；获得分离后或经体外金属簇重建后具有活性的 NifB；在酵母线粒体中产生 NifB-co；利用酵母线粒体纯化蛋白实现体外 FeMo-co 合成；以及从转基因水稻回收固氮酶组分并在体外证明其活性。不过，工程酵母或植物中的完整固氮酶活性尚未得到证明。文章讨论细胞器靶向、自然多样性及工程蛋白的利用，以及组装多基因途径所需的合成生物学工具，并指出植物中功能性 NifDK 组装、宿主代谢整合和协调调控等障碍，展望固氮作物开发前景。

papers.title: T Cell Receptor-Engineered T Cell Therapy in Solid Tumors: Where We Stand and What's to Come.
papers.abstract: T cell receptor-engineered T (TCR-T) cell therapy has emerged as a promising adoptive cellular therapy for solid tumors by enabling recognition of intracellular antigens presented via human leukocyte antigen (HLA) molecules. Unlike chimeric antigen receptor T cell therapy, TCR-T cell therapy targets a broader antigen repertoire, including cancer-testis antigens, neoantigens, and viral antigens. Recent clinical advances, highlighted by the approval of afamitresgene autoleucel in synovial sarcoma, demonstrate meaningful antitumor activity. However, several limitations remain, including HLA restriction, antigen heterogeneity, toxicity related to on-target/off-tumor effects, and mechanisms of resistance such as antigen loss and T cell exhaustion. Advances in antigen selection, gene editing, and synthetic biology are improving both safety and efficacy. Combination strategies and next-generation engineered constructs are expected to overcome current barriers. This review summarizes the biological rationale, clinical evidence, safety considerations, and resistance mechanisms of TCR-T cell therapy in solid tumors and discusses future directions to optimize their therapeutic potential.
papers.authors: Ferriol-Martínez C, D'Angelo SP.

enrichment.titleZh: 实体瘤中的 T 细胞受体工程 T 细胞治疗：现状与未来方向
enrichment.abstractZh: T细胞受体工程T细胞（TCR-T）疗法能够识别人类白细胞抗原（HLA）分子呈递的细胞内抗原，已成为实体瘤中有前景的过继细胞疗法。与嵌合抗原受体T细胞疗法相比，TCR-T可靶向更广泛的抗原，包括癌睾抗原、新抗原和病毒抗原。近期临床进展，尤其是 afamitresgene autoleucel 获批用于滑膜肉瘤，显示了有意义的抗肿瘤活性。但该疗法仍面临 HLA 限制、抗原异质性、靶向正常组织导致的毒性，以及抗原丢失和T细胞耗竭等耐药机制。抗原选择、基因编辑及合成生物学的进展正在改善安全性与有效性。联合策略和新一代工程构建体有望克服当前障碍。本综述总结实体瘤 TCR-T 疗法的生物学依据、临床证据、安全问题及耐药机制，并讨论优化其治疗潜力的未来方向。

papers.title: The Unfinished Story of Megakaryopoiesis.
papers.abstract: Since their nineteenth-century discovery, megakaryocytes (MKs) and the platelets they produce have remained among the least understood lineages in hematology. Understanding megakaryopoiesis and thrombopoiesis is essential for deciphering hematological disorders and developing platelet biomanufacturing and cell-based therapies. We revisit MK and platelet biogenesis, from MK emergence from hematopoietic stem cells to platelet release through proplatelet formation and cytoplasmic fragmentation. The growing complexity of differentiation pathways challenges the classical hierarchical view of hematopoiesis. Many concepts established in mice remain insufficiently validated in humans, motivating 3D bioengineered models for disease study that may rewrite key chapters in human platelet biology.
papers.authors: Gabinaud E, Goggi G, Alizadehghannad M, Balduini A.

enrichment.titleZh: 巨核细胞生成：尚未完成的故事
enrichment.abstractZh: 自19世纪被发现以来，巨核细胞（MK）及其产生的血小板一直是血液学中认识较不充分的细胞谱系之一。理解巨核细胞生成和血小板生成，对解析血液疾病、开发血小板生物制造及细胞疗法至关重要。本文回顾巨核细胞与血小板的发生过程，从造血干细胞产生巨核细胞，到通过前血小板形成和细胞质碎裂释放血小板。分化途径日益显现的复杂性，对经典的造血层级模型提出挑战。许多在小鼠中建立的概念尚缺少充分的人体证据，因此推动了用于疾病研究的三维生物工程模型的发展，这些模型可能改写人类血小板生物学中的关键认识。

papers.title: Binding pocket optimization of Pueraria mirifica type II chalcone isomerase synergizing with a necrosis-attenuating host transcription factor for persistent daidzein biosynthesis.
papers.abstract: Pathway reconstitution of leguminous isoflavonoids in non-legume plant chassis offers a tractably controlled environment to probe specialized metabolism, yet it remains critically bottlenecked by suboptimal heterologous enzyme efficiency and severe host tissue necrosis. Here, we overcome these long-standing architectural limitations by establishing a highly synergistic, necrosis-attenuated Nicotiana benthamiana synthetic biology platform. We characterized chalcone isomerases from Pueraria mirifica (PmCHIs), revealing that PmCHI Type II operates as a biochemical junction exhibiting a specialized substrate-dependent alkaline optimum (pH 7.5-8.0) exclusively toward isoliquiritigenin. Combining 500-ns molecular dynamics simulations with structure-guided mutagenesis, active-site engineering identified an I195V variant with enhanced isoliquiritigenin preference. The conservative I195V substitution was predicted to reduce local steric crowding and produced an isoliquiritigenin selectivity ratio of 1.63 in vitro. For in planta pathway integration, we delivered a polycistronic cascade using P2A ribosome-skipping peptides to streamline multiplex multi-gene stacking. Crucially, substituting the conventional Arabidopsis thaliana MYB12 regulator with a host-derived N. benthamiana MYB60 transcription factor successfully attenuated tissue necrosis, accompanied by reduced electrolyte leakage. Quantitative proteomics showed no statistically significant difference in PmCHI abundance between the I195V and WT-II treatments in planta, while independent plant batches consistently showed higher daidzein accumulation with I195V, although the magnitude of enhancement varied among experiments. The NbMYB60-based platform extended the operational viability window up to 9 days, delivering a robust daidzein titer of 1.5 mg/g DW at 6 days post-infiltration, with individual high-performing replicates reaching up to 2.5 mg/g DW. Together, these results establish an integrated enzyme-engineering and necrosis-attenuating regulatory framework for persistent daidzein biosynthesis and specialized pathway reconstitution in planta.
papers.authors: Suntichaikamolkul N, Sanachai K, Nutho B, Rungrotmongkol T, Tubtimrattana A, Thirati P, Sucharitakul J, Sirikantaramas S.

papers.title: Cytoskeletal and Extracellular Factors Regulating Stem Cell Differentiation: Mechanisms, Tools, and Emerging Applications.
papers.abstract: Stem cell lineage determination is governed not only by biochemical cues but also by the organization and force-generating state of the cytoskeleton, which integrates extracellular mechanical cues into transcriptional and epigenetic responses. Cytoskeletal organization and remodeling play essential roles in stem cell fate determination, as well as other relevant biological processes including development, tissue regeneration, and disease progression. In this review, we first outline the different types of cytoskeletal structures-actin filaments, microtubules, and intermediate filaments-and their coordinated roles in cell shape, polarity, and contractility. We then discuss how extracellular cues, including matrix stiffness, geometry, topography, shear, stretch, and compression remodel cytoskeletal distribution and adhesion dynamics to affect stem cell lineage commitment. We highlight matrix viscoelasticity and stress relaxation as time-dependent mechanical regulators that modulate traction transmission, focal adhesion, and cytoskeletal tension, thereby directing stem cell differentiation outcomes beyond stiffness alone. We next discuss mechanotransduction pathways, such as RhoA/ROCK-mediated contractility, Wnt/β-catenin, Piezo1/Piezo2, and YAP/TAZ nuclear shuttling, which couple cytoskeletal forces to gene regulation. We further summarize quantitative approaches to measure cell molecular forces, including traction force microscopy, molecular tension sensors, and advanced live-cell imaging platforms. Finally, we discuss the translational potential of cytoskeleton-informed design principles in regenerative medicine, where they can be leveraged to improve stem cell biomanufacturing, optimize tunable biomaterials, and develop more predictive mechanopathology models. Together, these developments will establish cytoskeletal organization as a controllable, engineerable lever for directing stem cell fate and enabling functional tissue formation.
papers.authors: Wang S, Caron J, Zhai S, Wang B, Mak M.

papers.title: High efficient production of adenine in Bacillus subtilis with novel metabolic engineering strategies.
papers.abstract: Adenine, serves as a crucial precursor for nucleic acid drugs and food additives, currently suffered from limited availability since its high production costs associated with expensive precursors and enzyme preparations. Here, we developed an effective strategy for high-yield adenine production using Bacillus subtilis as the host. Beginning with an adenosine-producing strain, we first knocked-out the apt and adeC genes, which were involved in product degradation pathways, and deleted the purR gene to alleviate the feedback inhibition on purine operon through CRISPR-Cas9 technology. Then, we overexpressed the nucleoside hydrolase RihC, PRPP amidotransferase PurF, and ribokinase RbsK to enhance the de novo adenine biosynthesis and enable the recycling of D-ribose. The production of adenine reached 18 g/L after the fed-batch fermentation, and the titer continued to reach 78 g/L when adenosine was added as the substrate subsequently, revealing the significant catalytic role of RihC produced during the fermentation. This work innovatively integrated de novo biosynthesis and enzymatic conversion strategies to achieve high yield adenine production in Bacillus subtilis, demonstrating a promising scalable process for industrial adenine manufacturing.
papers.authors: Han S, Shen P, Ren H, Xu J, Chen F, Huang J, Zhou M, Xu Z.

enrichment.titleZh: 利用新型代谢工程策略在枯草芽孢杆菌中高效生产腺嘌呤
enrichment.abstractZh: 腺嘌呤是核酸药物及食品添加剂的重要前体，但昂贵的前体和酶制剂使其生产成本较高，限制了供应。本研究以枯草芽孢杆菌为宿主，开发了高产腺嘌呤策略。从腺苷生产菌株出发，研究者首先敲除与产物降解途径相关的 apt 和 adeC，并利用 CRISPR-Cas9 删除 purR，以解除对嘌呤操纵子的反馈抑制。随后过表达核苷水解酶 RihC、PRPP酰胺转移酶 PurF 和核糖激酶 RbsK，增强腺嘌呤从头合成并实现 D-核糖循环利用。补料分批发酵后，腺嘌呤产量达到18 g/L；随后添加腺苷作为底物，滴度进一步达到78 g/L，显示发酵过程中产生的 RihC 具有显著催化作用。该工作将从头生物合成与酶促转化相结合，实现枯草芽孢杆菌高产腺嘌呤，展示了有望放大用于工业制造的工艺。

papers.title: Innovative Microbial Chassis for Systems and Synthetic Biology.
papers.abstract: The development of microbial chassis has revolutionized systems and synthetic biology, enabling the rational engineering of microorganisms for the biosynthesis of high-value metabolites ranging from pharmaceuticals to biofuels. This chapter systematically explores widely used and emerging microbial chassis systems, with a focus on their core biological characteristics, inherent advantages and limitations, cutting-edge advances in genetic and metabolic engineering, and real-world industrial application progress. Well-established chassis represented by Escherichia coli and Saccharomyces cerevisiae remain the gold standard mainstream platforms in both academic research and industrial production. Meanwhile, the growing global demand for sustainable, high-titer bioproduction has driven the development and application of functionally specialized industrial chassis including Bacillus subtilis and Corynebacterium glutamicum, which offer unique metabolic traits, exceptional environmental stress resistance, and broad substrate versatility. This chapter also discusses the core criteria for chassis selection, including genetic stability, industrial scalability, biosafety, and metabolic flexibility, alongside their validated applications in manufacturing a diverse array of products from bulk organic acids to complex biopharmaceuticals. By systematically comparing these chassis systems across key performance metrics, this chapter provides actionable insights into rational chassis design empowered by integrated systems and synthetic biology, to enable efficient, robust, and scalable biomanufacturing.

enrichment.titleZh: 面向系统与合成生物学的创新微生物底盘
enrichment.abstractZh: 微生物底盘的发展推动了系统与合成生物学，使人们能够理性改造微生物，合成从药物到生物燃料的高价值代谢物。本章系统讨论常用和新兴微生物底盘的核心生物学特征、固有优劣势、遗传及代谢工程前沿进展，以及实际工业应用。以大肠杆菌和酿酒酵母为代表的成熟底盘，仍是学术研究与工业生产中的主流平台。与此同时，可持续高滴度生物生产需求正推动功能特化的工业底盘开发，包括具有独特代谢特征、较强环境胁迫耐受及广泛底物适应性的枯草芽孢杆菌和谷氨酸棒杆菌。本章还讨论底盘选择的核心标准，如遗传稳定性、工业可放大性、生物安全和代谢灵活性，以及这些底盘在大宗有机酸至复杂生物药物制造中的已验证应用。通过比较不同底盘的关键性能，文章为融合系统与合成生物学的理性底盘设计提供指导，以实现高效、稳健、可放大的生物制造。

papers.title: MnWRKY22 Mediates Tissue-Specific Resveratrol Biosynthesis through Coordinated Regulation of the Stilbene Synthase Gene Cluster in Mulberry.
papers.abstract: Resveratrol, a pharmaceutically significant stilbenoid accumulates in mulberry roots. To elucidate the molecular mechanism underlying this tissue-specific biosynthesis, we systematically analyzed the stilbene synthase (STS) gene family in mulberry. Our investigation revealed that nine out of ten MnSTS genes form tandem repeats in a single genomic cluster. Co-expression clustering and phylogenetic analysis implied that these genes undergo purifying selection, resulting in highly consistent co-expression patterns across tissues, with particularly specific high expression in roots and calli. Subsequent weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) identified the transcription factor (TF) MnWRKY22 as a key regulatory candidate. Functional validation confirmed that MnWRKY22 is specifically expressed in roots and calli and directly binds to W-box elements in all MnSTS promoters, thereby activating their transcription. Suppression of MnWRKY22 expression significantly reduced both MnSTS transcript levels and resveratrol accumulation, while its overexpression enhanced MnSTS expression and resveratrol production. Notably, overexpression of MnWRKY22 in leaves ectopically activated otherwise silent MnSTSs, enabling de novo resveratrol synthesis. This study reveals the coordinated evolutionary characteristics of the MnSTS gene family and establishes MnWRKY22 as a unified regulator of tissue-specific resveratrol accumulation in mulberry. These findings provide a foundation for enhancing resveratrol production through metabolic engineering approaches.
